title: Weak order on groups generated by involutions
summary: In this article, we propose to initiate the general study of involution systems. An {\em involution system}, that is, a group $W$ generated by a set of involutions $S$, is naturally endowed with a {\em weak order} arising from orienting the Cayley graph of $(W,S)$. In the case of a Coxeter system $(W,S)$, Björner showed that the weak order is a complete meet-semilattice. This fact has many important consequences for Coxeter systems and their related structures.
